description: This file defines a set of functions for interacting with a backend API related to work items, comments, authentication, and other project management entities. It handles HTTP requests, error responses, authorization, and URL building for API calls.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if the API path is public (no auth required) based on route prefixes.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Constructs headers for API requests, adding Authorization when the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Processes error responses, handling 401 errors by clearing auth and redirecting to login.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend API, parsing the JSON response or handling errors.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, parsing response or handling errors.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters, handling response parsing and errors.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body, handling response parsing and errors.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item identified by project ID and item ID.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from local storage or explicit argument.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, setting created_by from current user displayName in localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for a given API endpoint path.
